$comment: Mobile feature parity (ADR-026): every desktop-only affordance in apps/app is registered here with the mobile path that reaches the same capability. `reflow` means the same control is reachable in a different layout; `hidden` means the affordance is desktop-only and names why. pnpm check:mobile-parity reads this file and the src/ scan.

entries.match: sticky top-0 z-40 hidden h-dvh flex-col overflow-y-auto border-r border-sidebar-border bg-sidebar-bg text-sidebar-fg md:col-start-1 md:row-span-2 md:row-start-1 md:flex
entries.equivalent: Desktop persistent navigation rail. On a phone the same nav tree renders in ShellMobileNav (features/shell/mobile-nav.tsx): a five-slot bottom bar carrying the primary destinations with the waiting-approvals count, plus a 'More' SheetDialog and NavDrawer holding the rest. The rail's foot carries the assistant launcher; NavDrawer renders the same launcher at its own foot, so ask_assistant opens from a thumb too. Every destination and control the rail reaches is reachable from a thumb.

entries.match: sticky top-0 hidden h-dvh border-r border-sidebar-border bg-sidebar-bg md:col-start-1 md:row-span-2 md:row-start-1 md:block
entries.equivalent: The grid column that holds the desktop rail. It collapses on a phone because the navigation moves into ShellMobileNav's bottom bar and drawer (features/shell/mobile-nav.tsx); the frame itself carries no affordance, only the rail's placement.

The word 'Search' beside the command-menu button's magnifier icon. The button itself is always rendered and keeps its aria-label, so the command menu opens by tap on every width; only the redundant text label reflows out below lg.

entries.match: ml-auto hidden rounded border border-border bg-hl px-[5px] font-mono text-[10.5px] text-dim sm:inline
entries.equivalent: The Cmd+K hint inside the command-menu button. It is aria-hidden decoration for a keyboard that a phone does not have; the button it sits in is always tappable, so the capability is unaffected.
